mode.description: Deploy mode: allInOne renders one workload, split renders the server and the dashboard.

digest.description: Digest of the server image, for example sha256:... . Replaces the tag when set.

secretKey.description: Key of the database Secret. Defaults to database.

existingSecret.description: Secret with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and optional AWS_REGION.

passwordSecret.description: Secret with the key password, rendered as INGOT_CLUSTER_PASSWORD.

credentialsSecret.description: Secret with the key nats.creds, mounted read-only.

securityProfile.description: Pod Security profile of the server. restricted sets the uid 977, restricted-openshift leaves the uid to the cluster.

maxRAMPercentage.description: Maximum heap as a percentage of the memory limit, as -XX:MaxRAMPercentage. Empty renders nothing.

initialRAMPercentage.description: Initial heap as a percentage of the memory limit, as -XX:InitialRAMPercentage. Empty renders nothing.

gc.description: Collector flag name without the prefix, for example UseG1GC. Rendered as -XX:+<name>.

extraOptions.description: JVM options appended unchanged to JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS.

enabled.description: Adds the OpenTelemetry Java agent to the server.

agentImage.description: Image of the init container that carries the agent jar at /javaagent.jar.

serviceName.description: Sets OTEL_SERVICE_NAME. Empty uses the release fullname.

endpoint.description: Sets OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT. Empty leaves it unset.

logsExporter.description: Sets OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER. none keeps logs off.
